## What changed and why

Link an existing issue if relevant and summarize the user-visible change.

## Verification

List exact checks and results. Explicitly list anything not run and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Behavior changes have regression coverage, or the reason is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs or personal data are included.
- [ ] Licensing and third-party attribution remain unchanged.
